title: Remote UE report procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: Remote UE report procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the SMF responds to a REMOTE UE REPORT message from the UE with a REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate the remote UE report procedure.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the SMF in response to the REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure transaction identifier included in the REMOTE UE REPORT message and copied to the response.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: IE containing EAP-success or EAP-failure message to be passed to the 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE.

entities.name: Remote UE handling information
entities.description: Optional IE included if PDU session authentication and authorization procedure was performed.

entities.name: Authorized QoS flow description
entities.description: Optional IE indicating QoS flow parameters to the 5G ProSe layer-3 relay UE.

entities.name: T3586
entities.description: Timer stopped upon receipt of REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by the UE after stopping timer T3586 upon receipt of REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE.

entities.name: EAP-success or EAP-failure received from DN
entities.description: Condition where SMF receives EAP-success or EAP-failure message from the DN.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization performed
entities.description: Condition where PDU session authentication and authorization procedure for 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE was performed.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization successful
entities.description: Condition where PDU session authentication and authorization procedure for 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE is successful.

relations.description: Procedure is triggered by receipt of REMOTE UE REPORT message.
Procedure includes sending REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.
REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message includes PTI IE from the request.
EAP message IE is included if EAP-success or EAP-failure is received from DN.
Remote UE handling information IE may be included if PDU session authentication and authorization was performed.
Authorized QoS flow description IE may be included if PDU session authentication and authorization is successful.
Receipt of REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message stops timer T3586.
Receipt of REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message may contain EAP message IE.
REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message may contain Remote UE handling information IE.
REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message may contain Authorized QoS flow description IE.
